description_en: Retrieves the list of routing policies for a VPC firewall for a transit router
description_zh: 获取TR防火墙路由策略列表
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-tr-firewall-v2-route-policy-list --lang zh --firewall-id vfw-tr-d5ba592ac6c84aff0000 --page-size 10 --current-page 1 --policy-id policy-7b66257c14e141fb0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTrFirewallV2RoutePolicyList

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall.

FirewallId is required. If this parameter is not specified, the ErrorParameters (400) error is returned. You can call DescribeTrFirewallsV2List to obtain the FirewallId. Prerequisites: CEN Enterprise Edition with a transit router and VPC mount are configured, and the FirewallId is obtained by calling DescribeTrFirewallsV2List
parameters.help_zh: VPC 边界防火墙实例 ID。本参数必填，缺失时返回 ErrorParameters（400）；可先调用 DescribeTrFirewallsV2List 获取
parameters.name: firewall_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10. For more information about paging, see the corresponding parameter descriptions
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，显示的每页数据的最大条数。默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number in a paged query. Default value: 1. For more information about paging, see the corresponding parameter descriptions
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The ID of the firewall routing policy
parameters.name: policy_id
